Theta GmbH's strategy of filing multiple patents for next-generation wireless communication poses a significant competitive threat. By securing these patents, Theta aims to establish a temporary monopoly on key technologies, which could directly hinder our development efforts. This legal maneuver may force us to invest time and resources into finding alternative solutions or navigating complex licensing agreements, potentially slowing our time-to-market and increasing operational costs. To mitigate this risk, we should consider conducting a thorough freedom-to-operate analysis, exploring workarounds, or engaging in potential licensing negotiations to ensure our product roadmap remains viable.
